Id.title: Id
Id.description: Opaque identifier. An address, never a permission.

CommitId.title: CommitId
CommitId.description: Full Git object id, never a branch name.

Revision.title: Revision
Revision.description: Investigation revision N. Human corrections advance it and fence stale work.

Cursor.title: Cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque. Bound server-side to principal, grant scope, snapshots, query and ordering.

RequestKey.title: RequestKey
RequestKey.description: Caller-chosen idempotency key. Same key + same args = same result; same key + different args = conflict.

DecisionCategory.title: DecisionCategory
DecisionCategory.description: Subject of a human decision (decision 0003). User metadata only: never a role, trust label or security guarantee. Absent means uncategorized; never null.
